Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multisensor Positioning/Sensor Models/INS.md
text: Simulate INS sensor, 6 inputs, 5 outputs, {Position error factor} sets Position error factor (m) [0 0; {Mounting location (m)} sets the location of sensor on platform, {Roll (X-axis) accuracy (deg)} sets the accuracy of roll measurement, {Pitch (Y-axis) accuracy (deg)} sets the accuracy of pitch measurement, {Yaw (Z-axis) accuracy (deg)} sets the accuracy of yaw measurement, {Position accuracy (m)} sets the accuracy of position measurement, {Velocity accuracy (m/s)} sets the accuracy of velocity measurement, {Use acceleration and angular velocity}, {Acceleration accuracy (m/s 2 )} sets the accuracy of acceleration measurement, {Angular velocity accuracy (deg/s)} sets the accuracy of angular velocity measurement, {Enable HasGNSSFix port} enables HasGNSSFix input port, {Seed} sets the initial seed for randomization and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.
